meditation.es:
En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

V. Ven, Espíritu Santo, llena los corazones de Tus fieles y enciende en ellos el fuego de Tu amor. Envía Tu Espíritu y serán creados.

R. Y renovarás la faz de la tierra.

V. Oremos: Oh Dios, que instruiste los corazones de Tus fieles con la luz del Espíritu Santo, concédenos, por el mismo Espíritu, saborear el bien y gozar siempre de Su consuelo. Por Jesucristo nuestro Señor.

R. Amén.

V. Oh María, sin pecado concebida,

R. Ruega por nosotros que recurrimos a ti. (3 veces)

Señor Jesucristo, que te has dignado glorificar con innumerables milagros a la Santísima Virgen María, Inmaculada desde el primer instante de su Concepción, concede que todos los que imploran devotamente su protección en la tierra gocen eternamente de Tu presencia en el cielo. Tú que vives y reinas con el Padre y el Espíritu Santo, Dios, por los siglos de los siglos. Amén.

Oh Señor Jesucristo, que para realizar Tus mayores obras has elegido lo débil del mundo, para que ningún mortal se gloríe en Tu presencia, y que, para una fe mejor y más extendida en la Inmaculada Concepción de Tu Madre, quisiste manifestar la Medalla Milagrosa a santa Catalina Labouré, concédenos, te lo suplicamos, que, llenos de semejante humildad, glorifiquemos este misterio con palabras y obras. Amén.

ACORDAOS

Acordaos, oh piadosísima Virgen María, que jamás se ha oído decir que ninguno de los que han acudido a vuestra protección, implorado vuestra asistencia y reclamado vuestro socorro, haya sido abandonado de Vos. Animado con esta confianza, a Vos también acudo, oh Madre, Virgen de las vírgenes.

Y aunque gimiendo bajo el peso de mis pecados, me atrevo a comparecer ante vuestra presencia soberana. No desechéis, oh Madre del Verbo Encarnado, mis humildes súplicas, antes bien escuchadlas y acogedlas benignamente. Amén.

ORACIÓN DE LA NOVENA

Oh Inmaculada Virgen María, Madre de nuestro Señor Jesucristo y Madre nuestra, penetrados de la más viva confianza en tu poderosa e infalible intercesión, manifestada tantas veces por medio de la Medalla Milagrosa, nosotros, tus hijos amantes y confiados, te suplicamos que nos obtengas las gracias y favores que te pedimos en esta novena, si son provechosos para nuestras almas inmortales y para las almas por las que rezamos.

(menciona tu petición aquí…)

Tú sabes, oh María, cuántas veces nuestras almas han sido santuario de tu Hijo, que aborrece la iniquidad.

Obtennos, pues, un profundo aborrecimiento del pecado y aquella pureza de corazón que nos una solo a Dios, de modo que cada uno de nuestros pensamientos, palabras y obras tienda a Su mayor gloria. Obtennos también un espíritu de oración y de abnegación, para que recuperemos por la penitencia lo que hemos perdido por el pecado y lleguemos por fin a aquella morada bienaventurada donde tú eres la Reina de los ángeles y de los hombres. Amén.

ACTO DE CONSAGRACIÓN A NUESTRA SEÑORA DE LA MEDALLA MILAGROSA

Virgen Madre de Dios, María Inmaculada, nos dedicamos y consagramos a ti bajo el título de Nuestra Señora de la Medalla Milagrosa.

Que esta Medalla sea para cada uno de nosotros una señal segura de tu cariño hacia nosotros y un recuerdo constante de nuestros deberes para contigo. Mientras la llevemos, que seamos bendecidos con tu amorosa protección y conservados en la gracia de tu Hijo.

Oh Virgen poderosísima, Madre de nuestro Salvador, mantennos cerca de ti en cada momento de nuestra vida. Obtén para nosotros, tus hijos, la gracia de una buena muerte, para que, unidos a ti, gocemos para siempre de la felicidad del cielo. Amén.

V. Oh María, sin pecado concebida,

R. Ruega por nosotros que recurrimos a ti. (3 veces)

En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.
meditation.en:
In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

V. Come, O Holy Ghost, fill the hearts of Thy faithful, and kindle in them the fire of Thy love. Send forth Thy Spirit, and they shall be created.

R. And Thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

V. Let us pray: O God, who didst instruct the hearts of the faithful by the light of the Holy Spirit, grant us in the same Spirit to be truly wise and ever to rejoice in His consolation, through Jesus Christ Our Lord.

R. Amen.

V. O Mary, conceived without sin,

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

Lord Jesus Christ who hast vouchsafed to glorify by numberless miracles the Blessed Virgin Mary Immaculate from the first moment of her Conception, grant that all who devoutly implore her protection on earth may eternally enjoy Thy presence in heaven who, with the Father and Holy Ghost livest and reignest, God, for ever and ever. Amen.

O Lord Jesus Christ who for the accomplishment of Thy greatest works hast chosen the weak things of the world that no flesh may glory in Thy sight and who for a better and more widely diffused belief in the Immaculate Conception of Thy Mother hast wished that the Miraculous Medal be manifested to Saint Catherine Laboure grant, we beseech Thee that filled with like humility we may glorify this mystery by word and work. Amen.

MEMORARE

Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary, that never was it known that anyone who fled to thy protection, implored thy help, or sought thy intercession, was left unaided. Inspired with this confidence, I fly unto thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother!

To thee I come; before thee I stand, sinful and sorrowful. O Mother of the Word Incarnate, despise not my petitions, but in thy mercy, hear and answer me. Amen.

NOVENA PRAYER

O Immaculate Virgin Mary Mother of Our Lord Jesus and our Mother penetrated with the most lively confidence in thy all powerful and never failing intercession, manifested so often through the Miraculous Medal, we thy loving and trustful children implore thee to obtain for us the graces and favors we ask during this Novena, if they be beneficial to our immortal souls, and the souls for whom we pray.

(mention request here…)

Thou knowest, O Mary, how often our souls have been the sanctuaries of thy Son who hates iniquity.

Obtain for us then a deep hatred of sin and that purity of heart which will attach us to God alone so that our every thought, word and deed may tend to His greater glory. Obtain for us also a spirit of prayer and self-denial that we may recover by penance what we have lost by sin and at length attain to that blessed abode where thou art the Queen of angels and of men. Amen.

Pray the Novena Prayer and Concluding Prayer

AN ACT OF CONSECRATION TO OUR LADY OF THE MIRACULOUS MEDAL

Virgin Mother of God, Mary Immaculate, we dedicate and consecrate our selves to thee under the title of Our Lady of the Miraculous Medal.

May this Medal be for each one of us a sure sign of thy affection for us and a constant reminder of our duties toward thee. Ever while wearing it, may we be blessed by thy loving protection and preserved in the grace of thy Son.

O most powerful Virgin, Mother of our Savior, keep us close to thee every moment of our lives. Obtain for us, thy children, the grace of a happy death; so that, in union with thee, we may enjoy the bliss of heaven forever. Amen.

V. O Mary, conceived without sin,

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

(mention request here…)

V. O Mary, conceived without sin,

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

prayer.es:
En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

V. Ven, Espíritu Santo, llena los corazones de Tus fieles y enciende en ellos el fuego de Tu amor. Envía Tu Espíritu y serán creados.

R. Y renovarás la faz de la tierra.

R. Amén.

V. Oh María, sin pecado concebida,

R. Ruega por nosotros que recurrimos a ti. (3 veces)

Acordaos, oh piadosísima Virgen María, que jamás se ha oído decir que ninguno de los que han acudido a vuestra protección, implorado vuestra asistencia y reclamado vuestro socorro, haya sido abandonado de Vos. Animado con esta confianza, a Vos también acudo, oh Madre, Virgen de las vírgenes.

Amén.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

R. And Thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

R. Amen.

V. O Mary, conceived without sin,

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

(mention request here…)

Thou knowest, O Mary, how often our souls have been the sanctuaries of thy Son who hates iniquity.

Amen.

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

R. Ruega por nosotros que recurrimos a ti. (3 veces)

En el nombre del Padre, y del Hijo, y del Espíritu Santo.

Amén.

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

R. And Thou shalt renew the face of the earth.

R. Amen.

V. O Mary, conceived without sin,

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

Lord Jesus Christ who hast vouchsafed to glorify by numberless miracles the Blessed Virgin Mary Immaculate from the first moment of her Conception, grant that all who devoutly implore her protection on earth may eternally enjoy Thy presence in heaven who, with the Father and Holy Ghost livest and reignest, God, for ever and ever. Amen.

O Lord Jesus Christ who for the accomplishment of Thy greatest works hast chosen the weak things of the world that no flesh may glory in Thy sight and who for a better and more widely diffused belief in the Immaculate Conception of Thy Mother hast wished that the Miraculous Medal be manifested to Saint Catherine Laboure grant, we beseech Thee that filled with like humility we may glorify this mystery by word and work. Amen.

MEMORARE

Remember, O most gracious Virgin Mary, that never was it known that anyone who fled to thy protection, implored thy help, or sought thy intercession, was left unaided. Inspired with this confidence, I fly unto thee, O Virgin of virgins, my Mother!

NOVENA PRAYER

O Immaculate Virgin Mary Mother of Our Lord Jesus and our Mother penetrated with the most lively confidence in thy all powerful and never failing intercession, manifested so often through the Miraculous Medal, we thy loving and trustful children implore thee to obtain for us the graces and favors we ask during this Novena, if they be beneficial to our immortal souls, and the souls for whom we pray.

(mention request here…)

Thou knowest, O Mary, how often our souls have been the sanctuaries of thy Son who hates iniquity.

Amen.

Pray the Novena Prayer and Concluding Prayer

May this Medal be for each one of us a sure sign of thy affection for us and a constant reminder of our duties toward thee. Ever while wearing it, may we be blessed by thy loving protection and preserved in the grace of thy Son.

O most powerful Virgin, Mother of our Savior, keep us close to thee every moment of our lives. Obtain for us, thy children, the grace of a happy death; so that, in union with thee, we may enjoy the bliss of heaven forever. Amen.

V. O Mary, conceived without sin,

R. Pray for us who have recourse to thee. (3 times)

In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit.

Amen.

Alcançai-nos, pois, um profundo ódio ao pecado e aquela pureza de coração que nos una só a Deus, de modo que cada pensamento, palavra e ação nossa tenda à Sua maior glória. Alcançai-nos também um espírito de oração e de abnegação, para que recuperemos pela penitência o que perdemos pelo pecado e cheguemos enfim àquela morada feliz onde sois a Rainha dos anjos e dos homens. ATO DE CONSAGRAÇÃO A NOSSA SENHORA DA MEDALHA MILAGROSA

Virgem Mãe de Deus, Maria Imaculada, nós nos dedicamos e consagramos a vós sob o título de Nossa Senhora da Medalha Milagrosa.

Que esta Medalha seja para cada um de nós um sinal seguro do vosso afeto por nós e uma lembrança constante dos nossos deveres para convosco. Enquanto a usarmos, sejamos abençoados pela vossa amorosa proteção e conservados na graça do vosso Filho.

Ó Virgem poderosíssima, Mãe do nosso Salvador, conservai-nos junto de vós em todos os momentos da nossa vida. Alcançai a nós, vossos filhos, a graça de uma boa morte, para que, unidos a vós, gozemos para sempre da felicidade do céu. Amém.

V. Ó Maria concebida sem pecado,

R. Rogai por nós que recorremos a vós. (3 vezes)

Em nome do Pai, do Filho e do Espírito Santo.

Amém.
